scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore --project havat-ravve
scripts.emulators: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-havat-ravve
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-havat-ravve "node tests/rules.mjs && node tests/rules-app.mjs"
scripts.dev: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only hosting,firestore,auth --project demo-havat-ravve
